name: Sumit Panda / ସୁମିତ ପଣ୍ଡା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sumit Panda writes poetry, stories for the screen and song lyrics in Odia. His screen work includes Byaase Sunucha, for which a 2022 report credits him with the story and lyrics. The film was directed by Sidharth Goutam and produced by Odians Originals.

In his Kabita Live poem “ପୁଅ”, the distance between childhood and adult responsibility is measured through everyday things: remembered school lessons give way to vegetable prices, electricity bills and loan instalments. A mother’s medicines and a son’s efforts to keep going bring tenderness into this account of the pressures of family life.
